noah: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp hit a strange embeddings issue. Using node batching helper + rerank endpoint. Some calls returned 0-length vectors, others returned 512 instead of 768.

anya: 0-length? that's odd. Are retries enabled? any fallback model?

noah: yes retry enabled. Minimal call:
```js
client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/rerank-1', input: ['a','b'], retry: { max_attempts: 2 } })
```
Raw headers showed x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-compact on retry and x-retry-count: 1. Also saw "Content-Length: 0" on one response.

rico: looks like two issues: (1) a retry path returned a compact variant (512 dims) and SDK assumed dims matched; (2) an upstream transient returned empty body and SDK normalized that into [] rather than surface an error.

sam: yeah parity gap: Python SDK raises on empty body, Node helper currently treats empty embedding array as valid and continues. That slipped into sampleapp.

noah: customer-facing break was similarity pipeline failing silently. Any quick mitigations?

rico: immediate: add a pre-check in sampleapp: if (!response.embeddings || response.embeddings.length === 0) retry or throw; and assert each vector.length === expectedDim before indexing.

anya: ops-bot: open DEVEX-4330 to track: node batching helper - fail on empty body, stop implicit fallback default, surface model_variant in response.

ops-bot: Created DEVEX-4330 and assigned to @rico.

sam: follow-up: change default retry behavior to surface the raw response headers (model_variant and retry count) to callers so apps can log and assert. Also add a short onboarding FAQ note about "why embedding dims may differ".

noah: I'll patch the sampleapp with shape assertions and a clear error message so users see the cause. thanks all :thumbsup:
